{{Quote|I remember our mother.''"<br>"''I'd like to hear about her&hellip; Father talks about her, but maybe your memories&hellip; are closer to the memories I '''should''' have of her.|Xanatos and Nason|<ref name="Dark Side 4" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''individual''' had two [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Parent/Legends|children]], [[Xanatos]] and [[Nason]], with [[Crion]], the Human [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Telos IV]]. Xanatos was taken to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as an infant to be raised as a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], while Nason remained on Telos IV under Crion's parentage. In [[53 BBY/Legends|53 BBY]], Xanatos [[Mission to Telos (53 BBY)|returned]] to Telos IV, where, after racing together on [[Swoop/Legends|swoop bikes]], Xanatos acknowledged that he still remembered his mother. Nason asked to hear more about her, however, Xanatos changed the subject to the scenery of the planet.<ref name="Dark Side 4" />
